en: The image depicts a large castle complex situated on a hill overlooking a river or lake, surrounded by trees. The architecture includes a prominent round tower and steep, gabled roofs, with a historical, medieval appearance. The text in the upper left reads 'Schloß Tzschocha im Queistal.' The colors and style suggest the image was colorized, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
